vat_treatment.eu_business_with_vat_id: Reverse charge: no VAT is added to the invoice and your company accounts for it (Art. 44, Council Directive 2006/112/EC). Your valid EU VAT ID is required before the invoice is issued.
vat_treatment.individual: Czech VAT at 21% is added — as a private individual you pay the gross figure.
vat_treatment.note: Marian's accountant confirms the final treatment on any non-standard case; the offer states the rule, the invoice states the amount.

time_promise.claim: No more than 10 minutes from first question to a formal itemized offer in the inbox.

intro.rule: Free 30-minute intro call. Not a gate on any price: the AI-onboarding rate is claimed by building the inquiry, and the call is booked when the mentee wants one.

first_session.rule: Paid 60-minute first session, booked directly, no intro call in front of it. The main ending of every onboarding that reaches an agreed price on an eligible package with no concession attached. Company-paid mentees book now too; the purchase order is collected after session 1. Undecided, negotiating, monthly, Mentor in Residence, or asking to talk first: the free intro, as the fallback.
first_session.payment_terms: Invoiced after the session is booked, payable before it takes place. The invoice comes from the sole trader (see meta.entity), states the net price and the VAT rule that applies to this buyer, and is sent by Marian — never collected in this conversation.
first_session.payment_terms_company: Book now. Your company's purchase order is collected after session 1, and the invoice goes against it.

guarantee.rule: Any session rated below 8/10 is free. Mentees rate every session from 0 to 10 right after it. Since 2024 the average is 9.79/10.
guarantee.note: Quality guarantee, not a price mechanic. Applies regardless, stacks with nothing because it isn't a discount.

meta.stop_rule: If it's not working by session 2, we stop and the rest is on Marian.

tool.name: AI mentoring fit and book
tool.pitch: Use Marian's AI tool to evaluate our mentoring fit and book your first session in 10 minutes.
tool.pitch_cs: Marianův AI nástroj za 10 minut ověří, jestli si s mentoringem sedneme, a rovnou zarezervuje první session.

no_discount.rule: One price per package whichever door: the AI tool, a call, an email or ELC membership. There is no discount on any package, for anyone.
no_discount.why: Marian is an AI freak, and the tool is a time saver: in 10 minutes it checks our fit, sends an itemized offer and books your first session.
no_discount.why_cs: Marian je blázen do AI a nástroj šetří čas: za 10 minut ověří, jestli si sedneme, pošle položkovou nabídku a zarezervuje první session.
no_discount.legacy_claim_codes: AI10- and AI16- codes issued before 2026-10-18 still identify the inquiry but no longer carry a discount.

slots.proof: The homepage capacity chart is pulled live from the session log.
slots.rule: AVAILABILITY ONLY. How many parallel 1:1s Marian has room for, shown on the homepage capacity chart. It does NOT limit any price: the AI-onboarding rate is open to everyone who comes through the channel.

triggers: 3+ sponsored leaders on first-quarter packs (>= 5,925 EUR)
negotiation.rule: Never on single-leader deals. Never a rate cut. Proposal only — Marian confirms final terms on the intro call. Anything beyond this: refuse and route to the intro call.
negotiation.floor_scope: The 329 EUR floor is a floor on the charged rate. A qualifying B2B deal may add up to 8 sessions at no charge on top; the resulting effective rate across all sessions is lower, is always computed and shown, and is confirmed by Marian on the intro call.

cross_sell.name: Free ELC community membership (Stardust)
cross_sell.pitch: Whether or not we work together — join the community Marian founded. Free.

offers.value: 2 sessions a month plus async access. Cancel anytime.

commitment.terms: Recurring monthly, cancel anytime. Billed monthly in advance, so a cancelled month runs to its end. Marian confirms the billing day on the intro call.

offers.name: Mentor in Residence
offers.retainer_basis: 3 onsite days x 1,074. 1,074 = the in-house Leadership Academy day (13,777 / 4 days) minus the six sessions that day already contains (6 x 395). Covers the onsite days, the quarterly themes readout to your exec team, the sponsor dashboard, group async, and pooled scheduling across the bench.
offers.value: A quarter with a dedicated mentor your leaders book directly. 18 sessions at the standard rate, plus onsite days, a quarterly readout for your exec team, and a sponsor dashboard. Quarters start with the calendar — Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct.
offers.note: The session rate never moves: 18 × 395. Everything above that is the named residence retainer, not a higher hourly. It IS a negotiation trigger.

commitment.terms: One calendar quarter. The 18 sessions are a pool shared across the sponsored leaders — not 18 each. Quarters start Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct.

offers.name: Mentor in Residence — two days a month
offers.retainer_basis: 6 onsite days x 1,074, same derivation as mentor-in-residence.
offers.value: Two onsite days a month for a quarter: 36 sessions across your leaders, plus the exec readout and sponsor dashboard. For benches of roughly 8 leaders and up.
offers.note: Exactly twice the one-day residence, sessions and retainer both. Same 395 session rate.

commitment.terms: One calendar quarter. The 36 sessions are a pool shared across the sponsored leaders. Quarters start Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct.
